paper_id: A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Business Object Association Model for Code Generation
title: A Log-based and Traceability-Oriented Business Object Association Model for Code Generation
motivation: 企业软件需要敏捷重构,传统过程导向建模不完备,且业务对象间关联频繁变化
problem_framing: 业务对象内部稳定但对象间关联易变,现有OO/E-R方法将关联编码为对象属性导致僵硬
key_insight: 将关联从对象内部剥离为独立日志,使简单操作处理单对象状态变更,复杂操作通过操作关联日志实现对象关联追踪
method_signature: 业务对象模型+状态日志+关联日志+简单/复杂操作分离+代码生成工具
evaluation_criteria: 二次开发周期缩短比例(从1月降至12天,效率提升60%)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 只能处理单据和资源对象,报表对象因数据来源复杂暂不支持;仅处理数值关联,其他关联类型未考虑
evidence_for_taste: cannot support n to n associations
increase the chaos of object structure
only if business object and the corresponding operation models are flexible enough
separate those unstable elements from those stable ones
elements that usually change are mainly the associations
the former mainly done during design phase and the latter mainly dealt with during implementation phase
thinking_moves: 从对象结构混乱问题反推关联应独立于对象
把可变关联从稳定对象中分离以实现关注点分离
将关联建模为独立运行日志以支持追踪和动态变化
将业务操作分为简单(单对象)和复杂(跨对象关联)两类
从代码生成目标逆向设计模型结构以保证可转换性
cites_own_work: WANG Z J, XU X F, ZHAN D C. Reconfiguration oriented business models for enterprise information system. Computer Applications, 2005
WANG Z J, XU X F, ZHAN D C. RO-BPM: A reconfiguration-oriented business process model. Computer Integrated Manufacturing Systems, 2004
WANG Z J, XU X F, ZHAN D C. Component Granularity Optimization Design Based on Business Model Stability Evaluation. Chinese Journal of Computers. 2006
